Select a palette by benthic group and domain

Source: R/select_palette.R
select_palette.Rd

Convenience helper to retrieve a named palette vector for use with cover_prop or cover_cat.

Usage

select_palette(group = c("hc", "ma", "sc"), use = c("prop", "cat"))

Arguments

group

Character. One of "hc", "ma", "sc".

use

Character. Domain: "prop" for cover_prop labels, or "cat" for cover_cat A–D codes.

Value

A named character vector of HEX colors suitable for ggplot2::scale_fill_manual() or ggplot2::scale_color_manual().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
select_palette("hc", use = "prop")

# Helper to pick palette by domain ('prop' or 'cat') and group ('hc', 'ma', 'sc')
ggplot(df_prop, aes(x = cover_prop, y = value, fill = cover_prop)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = select_palette("hc", use = "prop"))
  } # }
